name: BRIGHT-Pro
intro: BRIGHT-Pro 是面向 reasoning-intensive retrieval 的专家标注检索基准，扩展了 BRIGHT 的查询证据标注，并同时提供静态检索和 agentic search 评测协议。它为每个查询标注多方面 gold evidence，用于检验检索器能否提供支持下游推理的互补证据组合，而不仅是主题相似文档。
build_method: 专家标注, 多方面证据扩展, 静态与agentic检索协议
task_type: 检索, Agent搜索, 证据综合
eval_feature: 推理密集检索, 多方面证据, Agentic search
scale: 175个agentic评测查询子集, 7个任务领域
build_method_en: Expert annotation, multi-aspect evidence expansion, static and agentic retrieval protocols
eval_feature_en: Reasoning-intensive retrieval, multi-aspect evidence, agentic search
intro_en: BRIGHT-Pro is an expert-annotated benchmark for reasoning-intensive retrieval. It extends BRIGHT with multi-aspect gold evidence and evaluates retrievers under both static and agentic search protocols, testing whether retrieval systems can provide complementary evidence portfolios for downstream reasoning rather than only topical matches.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Start from BRIGHT StackExchange reasoning-intensive retrieval queries"] --> B["Field experts decompose each information need into compact reasoning aspects"]
    B --> C["Assign Likert importance scores and normalize them into aspect weights"]
    C --> D["Re-audit original BRIGHT positives, assign them to aspects, discard weak passages, and merge overlaps"]
    D --> E["Collect new aspect-relevant positive documents through web or AI-assisted search"]
    E --> F["Clean pages, remove boilerplate, manually trim noise, and segment multi-aspect pages into aspect-specific positives"]
    F --> G["Iteratively refine aspect schemas and run second-annotator checks for aspects, weights, and evidence credibility"]
    G --> H["Evaluate static retrieval with alpha-nDCG, weighted aspect recall, NDCG, and recall"]
    G --> I["Evaluate retrievers inside an LLM agentic search loop with citation-grounded answer judging"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.04018. The paper says BRIGHT-Pro builds on the BRIGHT StackExchange subset. Field-specific expert annotators decompose each query into reasoning aspects, assign Likert importance weights, re-audit original BRIGHT positive passages, merge overlapping passages, collect new aspect-relevant positive documents, clean and segment pages into aspect-specific positives, and iteratively refine the aspect schema. Each example is independently re-examined by a second annotator for aspect granularity, balance, weights, coverage, and evidence credibility. Evaluation uses static alpha-nDCG, weighted aspect recall, NDCG, and recall, plus an agentic search protocol where the retriever is plugged into an LLM search-and-synthesis loop.
